issues: Covers and sales rose week on week while spend per head dipped slightly.
Most sections of the site's KPI report were left blank.
Ikigai KPI 21/09: July and August sales were down on last year because students arrived late and the Fringe ended abruptly, leaving the street quiet for ten to fifteen days.
Ikigai KPI 21/09: September sales are back on track.
Ikigai KPI 21/09: Labour has come down following a restructure of the back and front of house teams, and Teddy Lee praised the financial control.
Ikigai KPI 21/09: The site will not accept labour spikes but accepts small food cost spikes, since stock stays on site for resale.
Ikigai KPI 21/09: Food cost runs slightly higher because pork belly and karaage chicken are prepared in house with trim losses, which the meeting agreed is justified by the quality.
Ikigai KPI 21/09: Mice in the kitchen were raised as an ongoing issue.
Ikigai KPI 21/09: Footfall has dropped because of intense competition from nearby noodle shops, although a new rival that was busy in August has since slowed.
Ikigai KPI 21/09: A student ramen promotion runs from 21/09/2026 to Thursday, replacing delivery discount campaigns that did not work.
Ikigai KPI 21/09: The tantan menu introduced in mid July, including the Tokusen tantan and vegan tofu ramen, has boosted sales, and the menu has moved from laksa towards premium tantan dishes.
Ikigai KPI 21/09: Card machine receipts show Maki Ramen, which may put off customers who want to support independent shops, especially as Maki Ramen does not promote Ikigai.

Ikigai KPI 21/09: The site received minimal marketing support beyond two visits and wants to shift to micro influencers, Google ads for tourists and TikTok visibility, and may print its own flyers if sales fall short.
Ikigai KPI 21/09: Service is fast, but the ambience needs improving, the upstairs seating is cramped and the downstairs seating is essential to hitting revenue targets.
Ikigai KPI 21/09: Teddy Lee encouraged using available budget to revamp the seating, subject to a detailed plan, and the revamp was left for further discussion.
